SERVICE AND RECRUITMENT RULES
SERVICE AND RECRUITMENT RULES
(Amendments)
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, Part I,
16h March, 2011]
No.SOR-III(S&GAD)1-21/2010, dated 2-9-2010.--In exercise of
the powers conferred under section 23 of the Punjab Civil Servants Act, 1974
(VIII of 1974) the Governor of the Punjab, is pleased to make the following
amendments in the service and recruitment rules of all the departments.
1. In the service and recruitment rules of all
the departments, where promotion has been prescribed as mode of appointment,
the method of recruitment is amended as under:--
(a) Where in the method of recruitment
for the posts in (BS-18) and below, promotion has been provided on the basis of
selection on merit, it shall be substituted by promotion on
seniority-cum-fitness basis; and
(b) Where in the method of recruitment
for the posts in (BS-19) and above, promotion has been provided on the basis of
seniority-cum-fitness, it shall be
substituted as promotion
on selection on
merit basis.
2. These amendments shall come into force on
the first day of January, 2011.
